 How can we make healthcare and insurance less expensive?
 For many Americans, affordability and healthcare was among their top issues hitting the polls on Election Day. Today on Say More, we explore why costs are rising and what we can do about it.

 Winter is coming. The holidays are near. But now is the season of open enrollment for health insurance benefits. And like everything from groceries to gas, the cost of healthcare is on the rise.
 Today, Say More sits down with an expert about why we continue to see healthcare become more expensive and how changes to the healthcare and insurance system could ease the burden on Americans. Plus, we hear from listeners about their insurance nightmares and how they’ve navigated a confusing and expensive system.
 GUEST: Lindsay Allen, health economist and assistant professor of emergency medicine, Northwestern University Feinberg School of Medicine
